field.name: ma_exemption_ratio
field.comment: The factor Form 1-NR/PY line 22 multiplies the exemptions (line 22a) by, carried to four decimal places as the instructions require: for a nonresident entry line 14g, Massachusetts-source income (14d) over total income this return (14f = 14d + 14e, result.ma_total_income) -- at most 1.0 because 14e is not less than 0; for a part_year entry line 3, days as a Massachusetts resident over 365; 1.0 for a full-year resident. Set by MA_Exemption_Ratio (#1201).

field.name: ma_income_threshold
field.comment: MA minimum income threshold for taxation (2025)

field.name: ma_non_ma_income
field.comment: Form 1-NR/PY line 14e, non-Massachusetts source income, not less than 0: the income that would have been reported had the taxpayer been a resident, from total U.S. income (Form 1040 line 9) less what Massachusetts does not tax. The engine models two of the exclusions the instructions list: Social Security and state tax refunds (result.state_tax_refund). The Social Security term is result.total_social_security, the whole benefit, because Calculate_SS_Taxability puts the whole benefit into gross_income and AGI; when that is corrected to the taxable part, this term must become result.taxable_social_security, and scenario MultiState_19 (which asserts the Massachusetts tax, not the federal AGI) will fail until it does. Not modelled, no field: U.S. bond interest, contributory government pensions, Keogh and 403(b) distributions already taxed by Massachusetts, the add-back of other states bond interest, Massachusetts public employees pension contributions; the foreign earned income and NOL add-backs do not arise because the engine never excludes the former from gross_income and takes the latter below AGI. Computed as gross_income - total_social_security - state_tax_refund - Massachusetts-source income, floored at 0, by MA_Exemption_Ratio (#1201).

field.name: ma_surtax_rate
field.comment: MA surtax rate 4.0% on income over $1,083,150 (2025)

field.name: ma_taxable_income
field.comment: MA taxable income (AGI minus filing-status exemption)

field.name: ma_total_exemptions
field.comment: Form 1-NR/PY line 4g / 22a, total exemptions before proration: the filing-status personal exemption (line 4a: $4,400 single or MFS, $6,800 HOH, $8,800 MFJ) plus $1,000 per dependent (line 4b, result.ma_exemption_dependent x the dependents on the return). Age 65 and blindness exemptions (4c, 4d) are not modelled. Set by MA_Tax (#1201).

field.name: ma_total_income
field.comment: Form 1-NR/PY line 14f, total income this return: line 14d (Massachusetts-source income, result.state_calc_agi) plus line 14e (result.ma_non_ma_income). The denominator of the line 14g ratio; not federal AGI, which differs by the adjustments to income and by what Massachusetts excludes (#1201).
